inlines.v: PE'ACEABLE, adjective Free from war, tumult or public commotion. We live in peaceable times. The reformation was introduced in a peaceable manner. 1. Free from private feuds or quarrels. The neighbors are peaceable These men are peaceable 2. Quiet; undisturbed; not agitated with passion. His mind is very peaceable 3. Not violent, bloody or unnatural; as, to die a peaceable death.
